signals.reason: Positive now (+0.95 pts) but was inverted as recently as Aug 2025. Recessions have often begun after the curve re-steepens.
signals.label: Yield curve (10y - 3m)
signals.rule: 10-year minus 3-month Treasury spread (FRED T10Y3M), percentage points. warning: 20-day average below 0 (curve inverted) weak: not inverted now, but a monthly average was below 0 within the last 18 months (recessions have often started soon after the curve un-inverts), or the 20-day average is below 0.25 (nearly flat) calm: otherwise

signals.reason: Above trend (101.00) and rising (+0.24 over 3 months).
signals.label: Leading index (OECD CLI)
signals.rule: OECD composite leading indicator, US (100 = long-run trend). warning: below 100 and lower than 6 months earlier weak: lower than 3 months earlier, or below 100 calm: above 100 and not falling

signals.label: High-yield credit spread
signals.rule: ICE BofA US High Yield option-adjusted spread (FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2), percent. warning: 1.5+ pts above its 12-month low, or above 5.0% weak: 0.75+ pts above its 12-month low, or above 4.0% calm: otherwise

signals.label: Initial jobless claims
signals.rule: Initial jobless claims (FRED ICSA), weekly, seasonally adjusted. Uses the 4-week average versus its lowest point in the past 12 months. warning: 20%+ above the 12-month low weak: 10%+ above the 12-month low calm: otherwise

signals.label: Sahm rule (confirmation)
signals.rule: Real-time Sahm rule (FRED SAHMREALTIME), percentage points. A confirmation signal, not counted in the forward score. warning: 0.50+ (rule triggered; historically a recession is under way) weak: 0.30+ calm: otherwise
